forbiddenChanges: No broad bypass, force push, parallel truth source, silent fallback, or deletion without consumer and data proof.
generatedArtifacts: Regenerate only from canonical contract or source owner when affected.
consumerMigrations: Enumerate and migrate direct and indirect consumers before removal or rename.
dataMigrationSteps: Use fresh, upgrade, replay, checksum and preservation paths for persistence changes.
compatibilitySteps: Keep compatibility only for an identified consumer with a dated removal gate.
cleanupSteps: Reference-scan and verify after the last write before removal.
documentationUpdates: Move durable decisions to canonical owners; the package remains disposable.

positiveCriteria.statement: Strict validation rejects zero inventory and unresolved plan gates; naming passes without broad exception.

negativeCriteria: No linked root cause, stale path, bypass, skipped required check or unverified consumer remains.
edgeCriteria: Negative, timeout, concurrent, retry, offline and unknown-result behavior is checked when applicable.
deletionCriteria: Consumer census, replacement, reference scan and rollback proof precede deletion.
mustRemainTrue: DSH owns operational truth; WLT owns financial truth; surfaces use the governed DSH facade for DSH-related finance.

claimsNotProvenByTheseChecks: Production behavior unless separately authorized and evidenced.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert only the atomic commit after preserving failure evidence.

rollback.contractRollback: Restore matching server, generated client and consumer state together.
rollback.operationalRollback: Return affected runtime profiles to the last verified SHA.
